prompt: Use case: faithful material/style upgrade of an existing original fan-game narrative illustration. The most recent reference image is the exact existing diehardman-rival.webp scene. Repaint this SAME image as a richly detailed realistic digital painting, keeping its composition, camera angle, crop, object identities, scale relationships, placements, gesture, lighting direction and muted gray-brown palette. Wide 16:9 narrative frame, opaque full scene. Preserve the foreground adult dark-brown bare hand and dark charcoal formal suit sleeve entering from the LEFT edge, with a small white shirt cuff. The hand reaches toward the RIGHT and holds exactly ONE small old brass key by its round bow between the fingertips; the key hangs downward near the lower-middle of the scene. Retain the key's recognizable simple silhouette, shaft and teeth. Preserve exactly ONE removed black leather glove resting on the diagonal dark ledge/table to the lower RIGHT of the key, fingers pointing right. Keep the original foreground ledge crossing diagonally from the bottom left toward the right side. Preserve the distant misty barren landscape, sparse dead tree trunks, cloudy brown-gray sky and the existing cluster of four small dark floating humanoid silhouettes on the RIGHT side in the distance; keep these figures soft, faceless and subordinate, in their original approximate spacing. Do not add any new people, head, face, mask, body, weapon, equipment, buildings or narrative object. The foreground person remains cropped to the same hand/forearm only; there is NO visible head or face to invent. Preserve the original visual story and negative space. Improve ONLY the rendering: natural adult hand anatomy and believable fingers with restrained skin pores, soft creases and fingernails; fine dark wool suit texture and seams; clean white cuff; convincing aged brass with small scratches and patina; worn supple black glove leather; fine weathered ledge grain and controlled realistic reflections. Paint atmospheric depth and diffused light in the misty background without making the distant silhouettes more prominent. Integrated soft cinematic lighting, nuanced shadows, carefully blended values and rich tactile detail matching the project's detailed painted narrative artwork. Avoid vector flats, cel-shading, bold drawn outlines, plastic mannequin anatomy, simplified cartoon hands or a flat infographic look. Keep the scene calm, solemn and unbloody. No added text, lettering, logo, watermark, border, montage or extra panel. Do not change object count or stage a different event. This is an original scene from the Death Stranding 2D fan-game, not a claim to reproduce an official cutscene.
